compound.label: Plus-que-parfait
compound.why: had already happened before something else

links: Futur and Conditionnel share the stem distinguer-. Learn one and you have both.
The Imparfait stem distingu- is the nous form of the Présent (distinguons) with -ons removed.
The Subjonctif stem distingu- is the ils form of the Présent (distinguent) with -ent removed.
The Impératif is the Présent with the pronoun dropped.
